function.name: READ
function.description: Read the contents of a single file from the local workspace. Supports line-based paging: use offset (1-based first line, default 1) and limit (max lines to return, default 400, cap 1000). Every line is prefixed with its 1-based line number and a tab. The result starts with a header 'Read lines A-B of N from <path>' and, when more lines remain, ends with a footer telling you the next offset to use.

force.description: Pass true to bypass the 5 MB size limit and read oversized files. Does NOT override binary file refusal.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return. Default is 400, capped at 1000.

offset.description: 1-based line number to start reading from. Default is 1 (beginning of file).

path.description: Path to the file to read, relative to the current working directory or absolute.

function.name: PATCH
function.description: Apply a change to a file and save it to disk. Pass find + replace to swap exact text (every occurrence), or content to create the file or overwrite it entirely.

content.description: Full file content to write. Creates the file (and parent directories) or overwrites it entirely. Use for new files or full rewrites.

expectedOccurrences.description: How many occurrences of find you expect to replace. Required when find matches more than once; the edit is rejected if the actual count differs.

files.description: Array of file edits to apply as a single atomic transaction. ALL entries are validated before any file is written; if any entry fails, NO files are changed. Each entry mirrors the single-file rules: pass content for a full write, or find + replace for a targeted edit.

content.description: Full file content to write. Creates the file (and parent directories) or overwrites it entirely.

expectedOccurrences.description: How many occurrences of find you expect to replace. Required when find matches more than once.

find.description: Exact text to find in the file. Requires replace.

path.description: Path to the file, relative to the current working directory or absolute.

replace.description: Text that replaces every occurrence of find. May be empty to delete it.

find.description: Exact text to find in the file, including whitespace. A unique match replaces one site; multiple matches require expectedOccurrences. Requires replace.

path.description: Path to the file to change, relative to the current working directory or absolute.

replace.description: Text that replaces every occurrence of find. May be empty to delete the found text.

function.name: DIR
function.description: Show the local project structure for a directory as a tree view.

maxDepth.description: Optional maximum directory depth to traverse. Defaults to 4.

path.description: Directory path to inspect, relative to the current working directory or absolute. Defaults to the cwd.

function.name: BASH
function.description: Run a bash command in the local workspace and wait for it to finish before continuing.

command.description: The bash command or script to run with `bash -lc`.

cwd.description: Optional working directory for the command, relative to the current working directory or absolute. Defaults to the workspace cwd.

timeoutMs.description: Optional timeout for the command in milliseconds. Defaults to 120000.

function.name: BASH_ASYNC
function.description: Run a bash command in a detached tmux session so it can keep running in the background while you inspect it with ASYNC_TAIL or attach manually.

command.description: The bash command or script to run in a detached tmux session with `bash -lc`.

cwd.description: Optional working directory for the command, relative to the current working directory or absolute. Defaults to the workspace cwd.

sessionName.description: Optional tmux session name to use. If omitted, a unique session name is generated automatically.

title.description: Optional display title for the background job. Defaults to the session name and a shortened command preview.

function.name: GREP
function.description: Search files in the workspace for lines matching a JavaScript-flavored regex pattern.

context.description: Number of lines of context (before and after) to include around each match. Accepts 0–5, defaults to 0.

flags.description: Optional regex flags to apply. Allowed characters: 'i' (case-insensitive), 'm' (multiline), 's' (dot-all). Example: "im".

glob.description: Optional simple suffix filter like '*.ts' to restrict which files are searched.

literal.description: When true, treat the pattern as a literal string (all regex metacharacters are escaped).

maxResults.description: Maximum number of matching lines to return. Defaults to 50, capped at 200.

path.description: Subdirectory or file to search within, relative to the current working directory or absolute. Defaults to '.'.

pattern.description: A JavaScript-flavored regex string to search for.

function.name: VERIFY
function.description: Run a shell command and parse its output into a structured test verdict. Detects bun test, vitest, pytest, python unittest, cargo test, go test, and tsc output formats.

timeout.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 120000.

function.name: FETCH
function.description: Fetch a URL via HTTP GET and return its text content. HTML is stripped of scripts/styles and collapsed. Requires DRIP_ALLOW_NET=1. Input: {url, maxBytes?}.

maxBytes.description: Maximum bytes of response body to return. Default 50000, max 200000. Content is ends-kept with an elision marker when truncated.

url.description: The URL to fetch via HTTP GET. Must use http:// or https:// scheme.

function.name: CHECK
function.description: Run incremental TypeScript semantic + syntactic diagnostics on the workspace. Input: {path?: string}. With path, reports full diagnostics for that file plus an elsewhere count; without path, reports project-wide diagnostics. Reuses a cached LanguageService per tsconfig for performance.

path.description: Optional file path to focus diagnostics on. Relative paths are resolved from the workspace root.
